The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) on Monday said it started its investigation into flood control projects in Taguig City, even as the Department of Justice (DOJ) clarified Monday that it did not order the probe.

NBI Director Melvin Matibag said the bureau was already looking into 11 flood control projects implemented in 2022 that were allegedly linked to some of the country's top 15 contractors.

“In fact, we are already investigating, kasi nung 2022 merong 11 proyekto diyan na somehow related doon sa mga pinangalanan na Top 15 contractors,” Matibag told reporters.
